title: feat(thoughts): hover swaps strip bg to coin
body:
## Summary
Adds \`group-hover:bg-[var(--coin)]\` to the bottom strip with a 700ms transition matching the border. Title + description stay \`--black\` so they read against the coin band.

## Test plan
- [x] dev server hover: strip flips cream → coin, text stays dark, border becomes coin
